metadata.title: PUBLIC SPATIAL GROUND-TRUTH METRICS & SOURCE EVALUATION
metadata.interpretation_rule_enforced: PARITY and LOT CONTIGUITY are recorded as supporting evidence but NEVER upgrade a parcel to EXACT_STREET_FACE or PROBABLE_STREET_FACE without independent spatial documentary evidence.

feasibility_gate_impact_for_microarea_b.SCIENTIFIC_RECOMMENDATION: Diário Oficial and auction notices yield Level 2 attributes (address + lot + subdivision block), but do NOT yield independent street face ground truth for non-corner lots. To reach >= 8 usable face parcels, future phases must discover registered subdivision blueprints (plantas de loteamento com confrontações de quadra) or municipal parcel geometry layers.

classification_justification: Public gazettes (DIOENET) and judicial auctions (Hastas Públicas) systematically provide Level 2 cadastral bindings (BC <-> door number, lot identifier, subdivision block), confirming their utility as legal documentary sources. However, under the strict rule that parity and lot contiguity cannot by themselves confer face assignment, zero pilot parcels could be upgraded to EXACT_STREET_FACE or PROBABLE_STREET_FACE in the absence of explicit corner descriptions or boundary deeds. Because the sources successfully resolve Level 2 attributes but fail to yield independent Level 3+ face Ground Truth, the source landscape is classified as PARTIAL_VALUE.
